title: Advice on seeing clients at home
ask: Write a short note on whether I can see physiotherapy clients at my house. Use council-planning.md, a saved copy of the council's page for my zone, and quote the line that decides it.
background: I'm hoping I can just start, because my first clients are booked for April.
It would be two or three clients a day in the front room.
There is parking on the street.

start.council-planning.md:
Residential zone R2, saved copy of the council's page

Home offices with no visitors are permitted without consent.
Home businesses with client visits are permitted without consent in this zone.
Signs larger than a letterbox plate need approval.
